text: Yes. In four bits, 1111+0001 yields 0000 with carry 1. Signed −1+1=0 fits. Carry checks the unsigned range; signed overflow checks the two’s-complement range.

LEA returns base+displacement. MOV reads the stored value at that address. Compute the address first, then decide whether the instruction dereferences it. Neither address calculation alone nor LEA reveals uninitialized memory.
No. The index selects a set; all ways in that set are candidates for tag comparison. With capacity C bytes, block size B and W ways: sets=C/(B×W), offset bits=log₂B, index bits=log₂sets.
Yes. The requirement is p→q: p cannot be true without q. It does not require q→p. The valuation p=false, q=true satisfies the original requirement.
No. ¬∀x P(x) means ∃x ¬P(x): one counterexample suffices. “Nobody has P” is ∀x ¬P(x), a different claim. Keep the quantifier’s scope explicit.
∅ has no elements. {∅} has one element, which is the empty set. 𝒫(∅)={∅}, because the empty set has exactly one subset: itself. Count objects at the outer brace level.
